summary: Covers deep-sea, coastal and river-way freight shipping, including containerised and bulk cargo. Disclosure topics are greenhouse gas emissions, air quality, ecological impacts, workforce health and safety, business ethics, and accident and safety management.

questions.text: What are your organisation's gross global Scope 1 greenhouse gas emissions?
questions.hint: Unit: Metric tonnes (t) CO2-e · Report gross global Scope 1 emissions for the reporting period, in metric tonnes CO2-e, covering direct emissions from sources you own or control.

questions.text: How does your organisation plan to manage its Scope 1 emissions over the short and long term, including any reduction targets and how you have performed against them?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe your short- and long-term strategy or plan, the emissions reduction targets, and an analysis of performance against those targets.

questions.text: What are your (1) total energy consumed, (2) percentage heavy fuel oil and (3) percentage renewable?
questions.hint: Unit: Gigajoules (GJ), Percentage (%) · Report (1) total energy in gigajoules (GJ), then the percentages for (2) heavy fuel oil and (3) renewable.

questions.text: What is the average Energy Efficiency Design Index (EEDI) for your new ships?
questions.hint: Unit: Grammes of CO2 per ton-nautical mile · Report the average EEDI of newly built ships, in grammes of CO2 per ton-nautical mile.

questions.text: What were your organisation's air emissions of the following pollutants: (1) NOx (excluding N2O), (2) SOx and (3) particulate matter (PM10)?
questions.hint: Unit: Metric tonnes (t) · Report the quantity of each pollutant separately in metric tonnes, stating how each was calculated or estimated.

questions.text: How long did your vessels spend shipping in marine protected areas or areas of protected conservation status?
questions.hint: Unit: Number of travel days · Report the shipping duration in marine protected areas or areas of protected conservation status, in travel days.

questions.text: What percentage of your fleet implements ballast water (1) exchange and (2) treatment?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) · Report (1) the percentage of the fleet using ballast water exchange and (2) the percentage using ballast water treatment.

questions.text: What were the (1) number and (2) aggregate volume of spills and releases to the environment?
questions.hint: Unit: Number, Cubic metres (m³) · Report (1) the number of spills and releases and (2) their aggregate volume in cubic metres.

questions.text: What is your lost time incident rate (LTIR)?
questions.hint: Unit: Rate · Report the lost time incident rate for the period and state the exposure-hours basis used (for example per 200,000 hours).

questions.text: How many port calls did your vessels make in countries ranked among the 20 lowest in Transparency International's Corruption Perception Index?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the number of calls at ports in the 20 lowest-ranked countries in the Corruption Perception Index.

questions.text: What is the total amount of monetary losses your organisation incurred as a result of legal proceedings associated with bribery or corruption?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report the total monetary losses for the period in your presentation currency, covering fines, settlements and other legal costs from such proceedings.

questions.text: How many marine casualties did your organisation have, and what percentage were classified as very serious?
questions.hint: Unit: Number, Percentage (%) · Report (1) the number of marine casualties and (2) the percentage classified as very serious under the IMO Casualty Investigation Code.

questions.text: How many Conditions of Class or Recommendations did your organisation receive?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the total number of Conditions of Class or Recommendations issued by classification societies.

questions.text: How many port state control (1) deficiencies and (2) detentions did your organisation have?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report (1) the number of deficiencies and (2) the number of detentions recorded in port state control inspections.

questions.text: How many shipboard employees does your organisation have?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the number of shipboard employees.

questions.text: What total distance did your vessels travel?
questions.hint: Unit: Nautical miles (nm) · Report the total distance travelled by vessels in nautical miles (nm).

questions.text: How many operating days did your vessels have?
questions.hint: Unit: Days · Report total operating days for the reporting period.

questions.text: What is your fleet's deadweight tonnage?
questions.hint: Unit: Thousand deadweight tonnes · Report deadweight tonnage in thousand deadweight tonnes.

questions.text: How many vessels are in your total shipping fleet?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the number of vessels in your total shipping fleet.

questions.text: How many vessel port calls did your organisation make?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the total number of vessel port calls in the reporting period.

questions.text: What is your twenty-foot equivalent unit (TEU) capacity?
questions.hint: Unit: TEU · Report your container capacity in TEU.
